question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Ledgible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be **'Legible'.**
 
• **Legible** means that is clear enough to be read easily.

 ** • Example-** His writing is so small that it’s barely legible.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4** which is incorrectly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The rest of the options are correctly spelled.
